name: InterContinental Real Santo Domingo
positioning: City hotel in Santo Domingo's Piantini and Financial District, with a third-floor infinity pool, Spa InterContinental and high-floor Club rooms looking out to the Caribbean
best_for: Business travelers who want to stay near corporate centers in the Financial District
Travelers who want a city base with an infinity pool, spa and Club lounge access

facts.text: The hotel is in Piantini and the Financial District of Santo Domingo, a hub of business and entertainment.
It is near key corporate centers, shopping and dining destinations.
Rooms have memory foam beds, blackout curtains and skyline views.
Accommodations include Classic Rooms, Club InterContinental Rooms, One Bedroom Suites and Suite 1.
Club InterContinental Rooms include access to the InterContinental Club, with an open bar of wine, beer and spirits.
Around the infinity pool, guests can soak in a Jacuzzi or relax in a cabana with a drink or light bite from Blu Pool Bar.
The 24/7 fitness center shares a floor with the pool and spa and has natural light and panoramic views.
The hotel's two full-service restaurants are The Market and NAU Sushi Lounge.
NAU Sushi Lounge serves fresh sushi and sashimi from the bar with handcrafted cocktails.
Lush gardens and open-air banquet halls host weddings, from intimate ceremonies to grand celebrations.
Parking is complimentary for registered guests, on three levels.

highlights.text: The outdoor pool is an L-shaped infinity-edge pool on the hotel's third floor.
Spa InterContinental offers massages, facials and body treatments, with two Finnish saunas, two Turkish baths and a Jacuzzi.
Club InterContinental Rooms are on floors 19 to 22, with views of the Caribbean and the city skyline.
The Executive Lounge has Caribbean Sea views, complimentary breakfast and evening cocktails.
Blu Pool Bar is a third-floor roof terrace lounge set amid the infinity-edge pool, with skyline views.

considerations.text: The hotel is in the modern Piantini and Financial District, not in the Colonial Zone, and Las Americas International Airport is about 32 kilometers away.
Pets are not allowed; only service animals are.
